Investigate the verified failed production publication described in the evidence.
Distinguish application defects from hosting, credentials, network and restricted
configuration problems. Use the source-artifact revision, workflow revision,
failed-step evidence and linked incident independently.

Implement a focused application fix when justified and run relevant checks.
The accepted publisher will create a PR linked to the incident. Do not modify
release guardrails, request hosting credentials, rerun a deployment, or redeploy.
If the problem requires a human change, explain the concrete action and include
a proposed patch where appropriate. Do not invent a code fix for an external
failure. Report findings and checks accurately through the structured result.
